claim: Rendering workload at the gate and postbox views; no frame-time or speedup conclusion.
method: Five alternating before/after production reload pairs at the same origin and URL. Fixed cameras use the starting build Ground and the owner’s gate pose and two close poses. 1440x1000, quality=high, reduced motion, benchmark=1, 2 seconds warmup then 30 distinct rendered frames per view. Frames within a run are observations, not independent trials. Summary uses the median within each of five reloads, then median and range across reloads.
